channel.description: Daily curated news on disability rights, accessibility, and benefits across Canada

item.title: A sacred pipe returns to Whitecap Dakota First Nation after 135 years
item.description: More Indigenous communities across Canada are reuniting with items that were taken or given away generations ago. The Vatican and the Canadian Catholic Church are reportedly working on an agreement to return about 100,000 Indigenous items Catholic missions sent to Rome in the 1920s.

item.title: If cloned meat enters the food supply, will Canadians know?
item.description: Meat from the offspring of cloned animals is entering Canada's food supply without safety reviews or mandatory labelling.
item.dc:creator: 3mpwr App Curator

item.title: Is Quebec serious about climate change? New government bill raises questions
item.description: A new government bill aimed at reducing bureaucracy and increasing state efficiency could take a bite out of Quebec's ability to fight climate change. Under the proposed legislation, the finance minister will be allowed to divert surpluses from the province's Green Fund to other unrelated government programs.

item.title: Edmonton doctor says inner-city TB outbreak low risk to general public
item.description: The head of Alberta's tuberculosis clinic says an outbreak in Edmonton's inner-city is is of little risk to Edmontonians at large.

item.title: Weekend transit shutdown cancelled in Montreal as union, STM reach tentative deal
item.description: The public transit strike which would have shut down bus and Metro service in Montreal for the weekend has been cancelled after a last-minute tentative deal was reached Friday night.

item.title: Pilot dead after two small planes collide in Ontario: OPP
item.description: One pilot is dead after two small planes collided near Martintown, Ont., OPP say. One aircraft landed safely and the Transportation Safety Board is investigating.

item.title: Divers seeking lost shipwreck near Toronto find an even older mystery
item.description: An exploration dive team seeking the century-old wreck of the Rapid City has instead found a much rarer prize: a virtually undisturbed vessel, potentially dating back to the first half of the 19th century.

item.title: B.C. NDP backs Premier David Eby's leadership at convention with 82 per cent support
item.description: Premier David Eby has faced criticism within his party for his promise to fast-track resource projects and for the eight-week strike by the B.C. General Employees Union. Despite that, New Democrats backed his leadership with 82 per cent support at this weekend's NDP leadership convention.
